name: Beetleflog
description: Land one blow then lift the head a hand-span and drop it again on the very same spot.

name: Bold Flatten
description: Flip the haft end forward between blows and jab it into the gap left in the opponent's guard.

name: Malletbarrier
description: Slide the lower hand open along the haft to catch a cut on the wood near the head.

name: Scudding Sledgeface
description: Follow the falling head with the lead foot so the body arrives right behind the landed blow.

name: Sledgethwack
description: Chain three heavy blows in a steady count with qi pulsing through the arms at each landing.

name: Tethering Wedgeface
description: Land the head on the opponent's raised weapon arm and burst qi through it to shake the grip loose.

name: Dollythwack
description: Aim the narrow face at the seam between two plates and drive it down with the whole body.

name: Ruthless Squash
description: Pound a padded guard with short straight blows until the padding stops soaking up the force.

name: Malletprop
description: Hit the opponent's shield arm with shoulder and haft together to pry the guard open.

name: Resolute Ironband
description: Turn the head outward and knock a sword edge off the armor that covers the body.

name: Springing Pommelweight
description: Stamp forward into the opponent's space so the next blow lands before any retreat.

name: Keen Pulverize
description: Rest the head on a plate and push qi through it for a heartbeat before the blow splits the metal.

name: Grim Heavyhelve
description: Strike the line of rivets with a sharp burst of qi to shear the plates apart.

name: Fierce Mallethead
description: Roll the head across both shoulders and bring it down on the side opposite where it began.

name: Thudslap
description: Turn the wrists so the head hooks around a guard and strikes the back of the arm.

name: Stalwart Endcap
description: Spin the haft through the hands to carry an incoming blade harmlessly past the body.

name: Squashthwack
description: Wheel the head overhead after a miss and let it drop again without stopping.

name: Ducking Maulhead
description: Cradle the haft behind the neck and step wide as the weight swings around.

name: Quakecurl
description: Roll the head under the arm and turn the body out of a close grapple.

name: Ruthless Thud
description: Keep the head wheeling through repeated strikes with qi flowing steadily from the back to the wrists.

name: Entangling Maulbutt
description: Spin the haft against an enemy weapon and burst qi through it to tear it from the hand.

name: Shardmallet
description: Hold the haft at arm's length before the body so cuts land on wood far from the hands.

name: Ironband Hasp
description: Twist the haft a quarter turn to roll a blade away from the grip.

name: Sturdy Gripbulge
description: Rest the head on the ground and lean the haft outward to ward off low cuts.

name: Humbeetle
description: Catch a spear shaft beneath the maul haft and lever it aside and away.

name: Brawn Quake
description: Answer a blocked cut at once by lifting the head over the same shoulder and dropping it.

name: Pirouetting Sledge
description: Weave the haft in small circles while stepping backward to cover the retreat.

name: Solid Maulbutt
description: Keep a steady stream of qi in the haft so it stays rigid through a long run of cuts.

name: Gall Quake
description: Hook the haft behind an opponent's wrist and pull the arm into the path of the falling head.

name: Rude Flatten
description: Take a hard cut on the haft and release the held qi into the head for a heavy reply.

name: Brass Heavyhelve
description: Start with the head resting on the floor and heave it up in an arc beneath the opponent's guard.

name: Brass Sledgeface
description: Plant the front foot before the maul lands so the leg takes the shock of the blow.

name: Brawn Pommelweight
description: Drag the head along the floor as the feet circle to a fresh angle.

name: Brass Maulhead
description: Rest the head low and tilt the haft forward as a short bar against shin cuts.

name: Gritmallet
description: Grind the rear heel and swing the maul around on its resting head to face a flank.

name: Rough Pulverize
description: Strike the ground just short of the target and let qi and rebound carry the head up into it.

name: Squashslap
description: Keep qi flowing through an advancing rush while heaving the head up from the ground at each pause.

name: Crimson Sledge
description: Raise the head past the crown and bring it down square on the target with both hands.

name: Draught Gripbulge
description: Sweep the head across at waist height and carry it straight back on the same line.

name: Hazebeetle
description: Angle the haft across the body and let a cut glance away along the wood.

name: Clay Thud
description: Shuffle both feet inward together to enter striking distance without lifting the heavy head.

name: Dire Mallethead
description: Reverse the maul and drive the butt cap into the opponent's breastbone.

name: Discord Squash
description: Trap an opponent's lowered weapon under the crossed haft and lean to hold it down.

name: Shard Wedgeface
description: Settle back with the haft slanted before the chest to cover the body after a swing.

name: Fierce Quake
description: Drive a surge of qi into the head at the last instant of a full overhead fall.

name: Quakescorer
description: Cross the haft to catch a cut then roll the head over to land a qi-forced counter.

name: Clay Gripbulge
description: Climb from a low sweep to a waist cut to an overhead drop while qi stays held in the arms.

name: Heavyhelve Scorer
description: Let the breath out in one push as the head falls so the blow carries the whole body.

name: Quickening Pommelweight
description: Draw breath into the belly as the head rises so the arms refill with strength for the next fall.

name: Regimen Wedgeface
description: Sink the hips on a long breath and hold the haft level so the body cannot be shoved.

name: Malletcurl
description: Match each step to one breath while carrying the maul so the pace never falters.

name: Cruel Squash
description: Sweep the haft out in a slow even count and strike with its length on the final beat.

name: Recallsledge
description: Hold the breath and freeze mid-swing so an eager opponent commits too early.

name: Ember Maulbutt
description: Tie every swing to one long slow breath with qi held low in the belly throughout the cycle.

name: Brawnmallet
description: Pour qi from the belly through the arms and into the head at the instant of the exhale.

name: Static Maulhead
description: Strike the side of the knee so the leg buckles and the stance breaks.

name: Dollybuckle
description: Slap the flat poll beside the helm to jar and ring the head within.

name: Buttressed Endcap
description: Meet a rushing attacker with the haft held low and shove them off balance as the cut lands.

name: Rill Sledge
description: Rock the weight to the rear foot and step back from a counter without dropping the head.

name: Hum Pulverize
description: Tap a raised guard from below with a burst of qi so it flies open for the follow-up.

name: Raw Ironband
description: Hit knee and ribs and shoulder in turn with qi held steady so the opponent never regains balance.
